headlines.headline: NBA strips Clippers of five first-round picks, fines Ballmer $30 million in Kawhi Leonard cap probe
headlines.detail: League concluded its salary-cap circumvention investigation tied to Leonard's since-completed move away from Los Angeles — one of the harshest cap-related penalties on record.

headlines.headline: Patriots sign CB Christian Gonzalez to 4-year, $135M extension ahead of Seahawks opener
headlines.detail: New England locks up its top corner one day before Wednesday's NFL Kickoff Game at Seattle, a Super Bowl LX rematch (5:20 PM PT, NBC).

headlines.headline: SEC looks into LSU after Lane Kiffin signs players cut from NFL camps
headlines.detail: Conference reviewing LSU's roster tactics, including its standing, after a legal but rattling roster-building maneuver following LSU's 51-10 Week 1 win over Clemson.

headlines.headline: Duke tops Andy Katz's first men's basketball Power 44 for 2026-27
headlines.detail: Six weeks from tip-off, ESPN's first bracket predictions and rankings for next season slot Duke at No. 1 as coverage shifts to season previews.
